Class Vision

java.lang.Object
org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode.subsystems.Vision
All Implemented Interfaces:
dev.nextftc.core.subsystems.Subsystem
public class Vision extends Object implements dev.nextftc.core.subsystems.Subsystem
Subsystem for robot vision processing using an AprilTag processor and VisionPortal. Manages camera stream initialization, target tracking, telemetry output, and cell detection.

    • init

      public void init(com.qualcomm.robotcore.hardware.HardwareMap hardwareMap, org.firstinspires.ftc.robotcore.external.Telemetry telemetry)
      Initializes the AprilTag processor and VisionPortal camera stream. Configures output units in inches and degrees with preset camera offset poses.
      Parameters:
      hardwareMap - the robot hardware map used to access "Webcam1"
      telemetry - the telemetry instance for logging vision data

    • periodic

      public void periodic()
      Runs periodically to update telemetry with AprilTag and cluster detection metrics, including count, camera-relative XYZ position in inches, PRY rotation in degrees, and RBE metrics (range in inches, bearing in degrees, elevation in degrees).
      Specified by:
      periodic in interface dev.nextftc.core.subsystems.Subsystem

      public List<org.firstinspires.ftc.vision.apriltag.AprilTagDetection> getDetections()
      Retrieves the current list of detected AprilTags.
      Returns:
      a list of AprilTagDetection objects, or an empty list if processor is null

    • getBestCell

      public Vision.Cell getBestCell()
      Evaluates detected AprilTag clusters and returns a Vision.Cell for the best detected cluster.
      Returns:
      the best detected Vision.Cell containing range (inches), bearing (degrees), elevation (degrees), or null if none detected

    • isCellScorable

      public boolean isCellScorable(org.firstinspires.ftc.vision.apriltag.AprilTagClusterDetection best)
      Determines whether an AprilTag cluster detection is in a scorable orientation.
      Parameters:
      best - the AprilTagClusterDetection to check
      Returns:
      true if non-null, has pose information, and absolute roll angle is less than 90.0 degrees; false otherwise
